questions.question_text: Explain the phrase 'Canary in a coal mine' in the context of this story.
questions.correct_answer: Historically, miners carried canaries because the birds were sensitive to poisonous gases. In the story, Claribel served the same role in space, detecting low oxygen before mechanical alarms worked.

questions.question_text: How does Arthur C. Clarke blend scientific realism with humor and suspense in 'Feathered Friend'?
questions.correct_answer: Clarke grounds the narrative in realistic space physics—microgravity, air ducts, and life-support engineering. He introduces humor through Sven smuggling a bird into orbit and Claribel's weightless acrobatics. Suspense peaks when Claribel passes out, creating a medical mystery. The resolution blends science with irony: despite millions spent on futuristic technology, an ancient biological sentinel saves human lives.
